name: GET /v1/estamp/states/availability - error-429
description: Rate limit exceeded, with one of two codes. TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: the per-minute limit of this endpoint (fixed window, per API key; sandbox keys get 20% of the production limit, minimum 1). DAILY_API_LIMIT_REACHED: the daily limit of this API (calls per API per day for your organisation and environment, reset at 00:00 IST) is used up; the call is not charged and your other APIs are unaffected. Both carry a Retry-After header (seconds): wait that long before retrying. For DAILY_API_LIMIT_REACHED that is the time to the next 00:00 IST, and X-RateLimit-Daily-Reset carries the same moment as an ISO 8601 timestamp with +05:30. In sandbox the codes SANDBOX_RATE_LIMIT, SANDBOX_DAILY_LIMIT (the organisation-wide daily cap across all APIs) and SANDBOX_IP_LIMIT (per IP address per day) also apply next to the per-API daily limit. Branch on error.code.
